subject: MAP sprint lane proposal + week0 workshop invite
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@novacorp.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: MAP sprint lane proposal + week0 workshop invite

Hi Elena —

Great to meet you on the call yesterday. As promised, I pulled together a lightweight MAP (Mutual Action Plan) template tailored to a short eval sprint. The doc is editable so we can lock in owners and dates during the week0 workshop.

Doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFGHIJ-map-template
Attachment: MAP_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub)

Key pieces included in the template:
- Acceptance criteria table (tech + business)
- Week-by-week milestones (30 / 60 / 90 day lanes)
- Stakeholder and decision owner matrix
- Tech validation checklist (integration points, sample data, throughput tests)

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick pre-kick call (30 min) to confirm stakeholders — are you available Monday 1/12 or Tuesday 1/13?
2) Week0 workshop (60 min) to assign owners and lock the first 30-day milestones
3) We’ll update the MAP and send a one-pager for procurement and SOW prep

If procurement needs anything in advance (SOW template, pricing bands, SOC2 evidence), loop them in and I’ll coordinate. I’ve copied Jonas to help with security artifacts.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Park <elena.park@novacorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP sprint lane proposal + week0 workshop invite

Tessa — thanks for the doc. A few quick questions from our side:

- Procurement will need an indicative pricing band and a short SOW outline before legal engages. Can you provide a one-pager?
- Security: our cloud security team will want SOC 2 artifacts and an overview of data residency for the pilot. Is the SOC2 link public?
- Timeline: 1/13 works better for internal stakeholders, but we have a hard freeze on vendor workshops 1/15–1/16.

Also looping procurement: procurement@novacorp.com — they’ll tell you the exact review cadence.

Appreciate it,
Elena
Product Lead, AI Platform
NovaCorp

Thanks Elena — quick answers from the ops side:

- Pricing / SOW: I attached a one-page starter SOW and an indicative pricing band for a 4–8 week pilot. That usually covers the procurement gate for NovaCorp-sized accounts.
Attachment: week0-workshop-agenda.pdf (PDF stub)

- SOC2 / security artifacts: the SOC 2 report is available here: https://redwood-inference.share/secure-artifacts/soc2-report-2025.pdf. We also have a short security one-pager I can share if they prefer fewer pages.

- Data residency: for the pilot we can pin region to us-west-2 and provide audit logs for the trial period.

If you’d like, I can draft the SOW language for the first 30 days (milestones + acceptance criteria) and drop it into the MAP doc. Tessa, can you take owner on that doc edit and add the proposed week0 agenda items?

Marissa Cole
